param-p01-v01.speaker: Śiṣya (student, invoking)
param-p01-v01.question: To whom take refuge?
premises: Supreme, beyond-abiding, depthless, beginningless, one, cave-entered manifoldly.
All-abode, all-moving-unmoving-abiding: to You, Śambhu, to refuge I resort.

param-p01-v02.speaker: Śiṣya (student, asking)
param-p01-v02.question: Who asks, and of whom?
premises: Womb-to-death sorrow-wheel-whirled, the student asked the blessed Lord, the support: the supreme truth.
param-p01-v02.inference: Whirled student asks support-Lord the truth.

param-p01-v03.speaker: Guru (answering)
param-p01-v03.question: How answered?
premises: By support-verses the teacher addressed him, its essence.
Abhinavagupta tells, by Śiva-teaching-view-yoga.
param-p01-v03.inference: Teacher answers in verses; Abhinavagupta retells Śaiva-wise.

param-p01-v04.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p01-v04.question: What fourfold, by whom manifested?
premises: By own-power-glory-weight, this egg-fourfold in division.
Power, Māyā, nature, earth — thus manifested by the Lord.

param-p01-v05.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p01-v05.question: Who enjoys therein?
premises: Therein within, this universe: varied body-faculty-world continuum.
And therein the enjoyer, embodied: Śiva indeed, fettered-state-taken.

param-p01-v06.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p01-v06.question: How contain all forms?
premises: As stainless crystal assumes various sorts' form, so the Lord too: god-man-beast-plant form-ness.
param-p01-v06.inference: Lord contains all forms as crystal takes colors.

param-p01-v07.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p01-v07.question: How move and rest with the world?
premises: As water moves, moves; moon-disc in stillness, stillness goes.
So this self, great Lord, in body-faculty-world mass.
param-p01-v07.inference: Self moves/rests with world-mass as moon with water.

param-p01-v08.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p01-v08.question: How perceived everywhere?
premises: As invisible Rahu, moon-disc-abiding, shines, so the all-going self, by object-resorting, in mind-mirror.
param-p01-v08.inference: Everywhere-self perceived in mind-mirror by objects.

param-p01-v09.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p01-v09.question: How manifest in purified mind?
premises: As in dirt-free mirror face shines, so this self, in Śiva-grace-pure mind-principle, shines light-formed.

param-p01-v10.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p01-v10.question: What replete with powers?
premises: Light-formed, complete, in own self from resting, great-bliss, by will-knowing-acting filled, endless-power-complete.
param-p01-v10.inference: Rest-replete self filled with will-knowing-acting powers.

param-p02-v11.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p02-v11.question: What shines, thought-free?
premises: All-thought-free, pure, peaceful, dissolution-rise-free: which supreme principle, therein shines the thirty-six-selfed world.

param-p02-v12.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p02-v12.question: How shine undivided yet divided?
premises: In mirror-orb, as city-village-etc.-varied, undivided, shines; in division indeed, mutually, from mirror too.

param-p02-v13.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p02-v13.question: Whence divided shining?
premises: From purest supreme Bhairava-knowing, so, though division-void: mutually, thence too, divided shines this world.

param-p02-v14.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p02-v14.question: Who illumines the five?
premises: Śiva-Śakti-Sadāśiva-ness, Īśvara-Vidyā-made principle-state: of five powers, by divided nature, He illumines.

param-p02-v15.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p02-v15.question: What veils by supreme freedom?
premises: Supreme freedom, difficult-effecting, of the great Lord: goddess Māyā-power, own-self-veiling of Śiva — this.
uncertainties: Print itat (probable etat); B1b line mismatched (witness misalignment, not followed).

param-p02-v16.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p02-v16.question: How bound by six?
premises: By Māyā-grasp-power, knowing stained, person becomes bound-beast; by time-art-limitation-power, by passion-ignorance bound.
uncertainties: B1b line mismatched (purusa-tattva general); followed Sanskrit.

param-p02-v17.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p02-v17.question: What does the atom know?
premises: Right now, a little, this, by whole self I know: Māyā-with sheath-six of atom, inner limb, this said.
param-p02-v17.inference: Atom knows little now; six sheaths inner.

param-p02-v18.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p02-v18.question: How husk, yet undivided?
premises: As husk on settled rice-grain: separate though undivided; attains purity by Śiva-path-eagerness-yoga.

param-p02-v19.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p02-v19.question: What mere proceedings?
premises: Pleasure-pain-delusion-mere, from resolve-volition-egotism; then inner-organ: intellect-mind-egotism in order.
param-p02-v19.inference: Mere proceedings from resolve; inner organ ordered.

param-p03-v20.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p03-v20.question: Which organs?
premises: Ear, skin-eye-tongue-nose: intellect-organs in sound-etc.; speech-hand-foot-anus-privates: action-organs again.

param-p03-v21.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p03-v21.question: What subtle objects?
premises: Of these, graspable object, subtle, division-free: tanmātra-five — sound, touch, form, taste, smell.

param-p03-v22.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p03-v22.question: How gross from subtle?
premises: By this combination, gross object goes to element-five-ness: sky, wind, fire, water, earth.

param-p03-v23.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p03-v23.question: How creation covers?
premises: As husk covers rice-grain, nature-first creation covers; earth-ending, this consciousness by body-state.

param-p03-v24.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p03-v24.question: What three coverings?
premises: Supreme covering, impurity here: subtle Māyā-etc.-sheath, gross outer body-formed; sheath-triple-wrapped indeed is self.

param-p03-v25.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p03-v25.question: How perceive manifoldly?
premises: By ignorance-darkness-yoga, one though own nature self perceives manifoldly by grasper-grasped variety.

param-p03-v26.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p03-v26.question: How states divide?
premises: As sugarcane-juice in molasses-sugar-lumps, so states-divisions all of supreme self Śambhu.
param-p03-v26.inference: One juice, many sweets: states divide.

param-p03-v27.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p03-v27.question: What merely conventional?
premises: Knowing-inner-ruler-breath-all-body-born-lumps: mere convention, in truth not at all.

param-p03-v28.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p03-v28.question: How powerful delusion?
premises: In rope no snake, yet fear causes till death-ending: delusion's great power none can discriminate.

param-p04-v29.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p04-v29.question: How arise the unreal?
premises: So dharma-adharma-heaven-hell-birth-death-pleasure-pain, caste-stage-etc., in self though unreal, arises by delusion-power.

param-p04-v30.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p04-v30.question: What darkness?
premises: This that darkness which, shining in things, becomes not-self-conceit even in self-unsurpassed: this.
param-p04-v30.inference: Shining-things darkness: self taken as not-self.

param-p04-v31.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p04-v31.question: How dark upon dark?
premises: Darkness upon darkness, great burst upon cheek: that in non-self body-breath-etc., self-ness.
param-p04-v31.inference: Non-self taken as self: burst upon burst.

param-p04-v32.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p04-v32.question: How net-wrapped?
premises: By body-breath-reflection-mind-knowing-sky-expanse-yoga, self wraps itself, wonder, by net, as net-maker.

param-p04-v33.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p04-v33.question: Whose play?
premises: By own-knowing-glory-shining-yoga unwrapping own self: thus bondage-liberation-wondrous play spreads supreme Śiva.

param-p04-v34.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p04-v34.question: How unveiled in states?
premises: Creation-keeping-loosing, waking-dreaming, deep-sleep: therein shine in fourth abode, yet unveiled shines.
param-p04-v34.inference: States shine in fourth, unveiling it.

param-p04-v35.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p04-v35.question: Which state beyond?
premises: Waking universe by difference, dreaming splendor by light-glory, knower sleep-state by knowing-mass: thence beyond, fourth.

param-p04-v36.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p04-v36.question: How untouched?
premises: As cloud-smoke-dust soils not sky-surface, so by Māyā-changes untouched stands supreme person.

param-p04-v37.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p04-v37.question: How unstained among stained?
premises: In one jar-sky by dust pervaded, others become not soiled: so these souls pleasure-pain-difference-enjoying.
param-p04-v37.inference: One jar dusty, others clean: souls unstained.

param-p05-v38.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p05-v38.question: How seem otherwise?
premises: In calm calm, in glad glad, the deluded; in principles being, the Lord not so in truth.
param-p05-v38.inference: Seeming follows states; Lord truly not so.

param-p05-v39.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p05-v39.question: How shatter double delusion?
premises: Which non-self-mirroring first removed, in self non-self-formed delusion shatters supreme self.

param-p05-v40.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p05-v40.question: What of the done-done?
premises: Thus in delusion-pair-root-cutting, of goal-gained: duty-other-weighing never for supreme yogin.

param-p05-v41.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p05-v41.question: What remains?
premises: Earth, nature, Māyā triad, known-form-fallen, by nondual-contemplation-power becomes mere-being-remainder.

param-p05-v42.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p05-v42.question: How all shines as being?
premises: As girdle-earring-bracelet by difference-leaving seen as gold, so in difference-leaving mere-being all shines.

param-p05-v43.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p05-v43.question: Where rests brahman?
premises: That brahman supreme pure peaceful nondual-natured even whole, deathless true, rests in shining-formed power.

param-p05-v44.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p05-v44.question: What sky-flower?
premises: Desired, known, done — by shining-formed: untouched, yet sky-flower-ness gets.

param-p05-v45.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p05-v45.question: How all emitted?
premises: By power-trident-grasp-yoga, whole, in supreme Lord, in Śiva-name, in supreme truth, emitted by god-of-gods.

param-p05-v46.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p05-v46.question: What thrice-created?
premises: Again by five-power-spreading-order, outside, that egg-three varied created by outer-self-gaining.

param-p06-v47.speaker: Yogin (first-person)
param-p06-v47.question: Who drives the wheel?
premises: Thus power-wheel-machine by play-discipline driving, god: I indeed pure-formed, power-great-wheel-lord-seat-standing.

param-p06-v48.speaker: Yogin (first-person)
param-p06-v48.question: Whence all spreads?
premises: In me indeed shines universe, as in spotless mirror jars; from me spreads all, as dream-variety from sleeper.

param-p06-v49.speaker: Yogin (first-person)
param-p06-v49.question: Whose form all things?
premises: I indeed universe-formed, hand-foot-etc.-natured as body; in all I indeed shine, light-natured.

param-p06-v50.speaker: Yogin (first-person)
param-p06-v50.question: Who seer, yet composer?
premises: Seer, hearer, smeller, body-sense-bereft though, non-doer too: system-text-reasoning-parts varied I indeed compose.

param-p06-v51.speaker: Yogin (first-person)
param-p06-v51.question: How dissolve in brahman?
premises: Thus duality-thought dissolved, crossing enchanting Māyā: as in water water, in milk milk, in brahman dissolved may be.

param-p06-v52.speaker: Yogin (first-person)
param-p06-v52.question: What sorrow then?
premises: Thus in principle-host by contemplation Śiva-made-ness attained: what sorrow, what delusion, for brahman-beholding?

param-p06-v53.speaker: Yogin (first-person)
param-p06-v53.question: Why association faults?
premises: Deed-fruit good-bad by false-knowing from contact indeed: hard is contact-fault, as thief-company though of non-thief.
param-p06-v53.inference: Fruits from contact; company faults hard.

param-p06-v54.speaker: Yogin (first-person)
param-p06-v54.question: Where go fools?
premises: Of world-convention-makers who here ignorance attend, fools go birth-deaths, duty-lock-bound.

param-p06-v55.speaker: Yogin (first-person)
param-p06-v55.question: How deeds perish?
premises: By-ignorance-time-heaped duty-formed yet deed too, long-heaped as cotton, perishes by knowing-flame-power.

param-p07-v56.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p07-v56.question: How end rebirth?
premises: Done though, not for fruit: thence how birth? Gone-birth-bond-yoked shines Śiva-sun by own rays.
param-p07-v56.inference: Done fruitless; birth ended; Śiva-sun shines.

param-p07-v57.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p07-v57.question: How no sprouting?
premises: As husk-cover-bran-freed seed makes no sprout, so atom-Māyā-deed-freed self no birth-sprout indeed.
param-p07-v57.inference: Freed seed unsprouting; freed self unbirthing.

param-p07-v58.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p07-v58.question: Why fearless, griefless?
premises: Self-knower fears nowhere: all his own form; grieves not, since in truth perished-ness is not.
param-p07-v58.inference: Own-formed all: no fear, no grief.

param-p07-v59.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p07-v59.question: Whose misfortune?
premises: By supersecret-heart-treasury-sprouted-truth-jewel-heap: I indeed in great-Lord-state — what, whose misfortune?

param-p07-v60.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p07-v60.question: Where is liberation?
premises: Of liberation no abode at all, nor going elsewhere: by ignorance-knot-cutting, own-power-manifestation is liberation.

param-p07-v61.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p07-v61.question: Who freed in body?
premises: Cut-ignorance-knotted, gone-doubted, cast-off-deluded, wasted-merit-demerited: in body-yoked though, he freed.

param-p07-v62.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p07-v62.question: How deeds burnt?
premises: As fire-inflamed seed goes sprout-powerless, by knowing-fire-burnt thus deed birth-giving not becomes.
param-p07-v62.inference: Burnt seed unsprouting; burnt deed unbirthing.

param-p07-v63.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p07-v63.question: How knowing contracts?
premises: By limited-mind-ness, by deed-fit-state-body-contemplating, contracted knowing shines on body-falling.
param-p07-v63.inference: Limited mind contracts knowing to body.

param-p07-v64.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p07-v64.question: What stainless vow?
premises: If again stainless knowing, all-transcended-knower-doer-made, spread, unset-unrisen-light-formed, true-resolved.

param-p08-v65.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p08-v65.question: Who beyond time-space?
premises: Direction-time-touch-free, firm, changeless, Lord full: many-power-host-dissolution-rise-making one-doer.

param-p08-v66.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p08-v66.question: How no wandering?
premises: Creation-etc-rule-wise-maker, self Śiva-made, awaken: how wanderer could be? Of spread, whence, where, or refuge?

param-p08-v67.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p08-v67.question: Why knower fruitless?
premises: Thus by reasons proved: knower's deed fruitless; not-mine-this but his, firmly: no fruit in world.

param-p08-v68.speaker: Yogin (first-person)
param-p08-v68.question: How become flame?
premises: Thus all-thoughts awakened by contemplation-wind: in self-flame blazed, sacrificing, flame-become.

param-p08-v69.speaker: Yogin (first-person)
param-p08-v69.question: How freed anywhere?
premises: Eating what or that, covered by whatever, calmed, anywhere dwelling, freed all-beings-self.

param-p08-v70.speaker: Yogin (first-person)
param-p08-v70.question: How stainless amid extremes?
premises: Horse-rite-hundred-thousands though doing, brahmin-kill-hundred-thousands: truth-knower by merits not, by demerits not touched, stainless.

param-p08-v71.speaker: Yogin (first-person)
param-p08-v71.question: How move opinion-free?
premises: Pride-joy-etc.-leaving, no-praise-formula, dull as, should move opinion-free.

param-p08-v72.speaker: Yogin (first-person)
param-p08-v72.question: How untouched by host?
premises: Pride-joy-etc. host arises from difference-delusion: nondual-self-awakened thereby how touched indeed?

param-p08-v73.speaker: Yogin (first-person)
param-p08-v73.question: What needs no praise?
premises: To-be-praised or to-be-offered is not, separate from him, anything: by praise-etc. he pleased, freed — no bow-formula.

param-p09-v74.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p09-v74.question: Whose temple?
premises: Thirty-six-principle-bearing, body-making-window-eyed-full: own, other, then body, jar-etc., his god-house.

param-p09-v75.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p09-v75.question: Whom worship?
premises: There, supreme-self-great-Bhairava-Śiva-goddess, own-power-yoked, by self-grasp-pure-substances worshipping sits.

param-p09-v76.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p09-v76.question: What effortless offering?
premises: Outer-inner-fancying-difference-great-seed-heap of offering, in his blazing-knowing-fire, by effort without becomes offering.

param-p09-v77.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p09-v77.question: What unceasing meditation?
premises: Meditation unset again: this blessed Lord varied-forms creates; that indeed meditation, fancy-drawn-true-formed-ness.

param-p09-v78.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p09-v78.question: What silent reciting?
premises: World-rows whole, principle-order-fancying, then sense-host, in inner-knowing turning: he — his muttering said.

param-p09-v79.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p09-v79.question: What even glance?
premises: All by even glance seeing, knowing deemed, world-burning-ground-delighting, body-skull-staff-fancying-grasped.

param-p09-v80.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p09-v80.question: What hard-easy vow?
premises: World-essence-drink-filled, own-hand-held, known-fragment-bowl tasting: this vow hard-to-get and easy-to-get.

param-p09-v81.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p09-v81.question: Who stands done-done?
premises: Thus birth-death-free, truth-great-Lord-named, having got, by finder-shining done-done stands as-wished.

param-p09-v82.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p09-v82.question: Who becomes that?
premises: Pervading told thus, all-self diversity-shaken, peerless-supreme-bliss: who knows becomes made-of-that.

param-p10-v83.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p10-v83.question: Where go though dying?
premises: In shrine or outcaste-hut, lost-memory though, abandoning body: knowing-simultaneous-freed goes isolation, killed-sorrow.

param-p10-v84.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p10-v84.question: What use rites?
premises: For merit shrine-service, for hell outcaste-death: in merit-demerit-stain-touch-absence, what thereby?

param-p10-v85.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p10-v85.question: How no rejoining?
premises: Husk-bran-well-separated rice-grain husk-piece-between-throwing makes not again that-form-identity.

param-p10-v86.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p10-v86.question: How freed though staying?
premises: So sheath-curtain-separated knowing here by impression, standing though, freed self, that-touch-free becomes.

param-p10-v87.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p10-v87.question: How gem-clear?
premises: By skilled-artisan-made-flawless-ness, of casket-condition: stained though gem, on condition-cutting clear-truth.

param-p10-v88.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p10-v88.question: How Śiva-formed?
premises: Thus true-teacher-teaching-pure-state, feeling body-condition, freed though condition-other-void, as shines Śiva-formed.

param-p10-v89.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p10-v89.question: What before heaven-hell?
premises: By scripture-authority, by unshaken-faith-too that-made-ness got, he indeed before heaven hell man-ness.

param-p10-v90.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p10-v90.question: When moment cause?
premises: Last moment in merit-demerit state nourishing goes helper-state; in going, not cause.

param-p10-v91.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p10-v91.question: Who goes right though beast?
premises: Who though that-self-ness know, beast-bird-creeper-etc., own-going: though by old-awakening-impressed that going go.

param-p11-v92.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p11-v92.question: Who between bodies?
premises: Heaven-made hell-made: this body-between-gone person; on that breaking by own-fitness body-other-yoking goes-to.

param-p11-v93.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p11-v93.question: How same after death?
premises: Thus in knowing-time own self once as shone: such indeed then, on body-falling not otherwise becomes.

param-p11-v94.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p11-v94.question: What death-signs?
premises: Faculty-host-theft, memory-loss, breath-choking, cutting, vitals pain-sorts, body-impression-born enjoyment.

param-p11-v95.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p11-v95.question: How unfallen knower?
premises: He how in body-yoked being not could be? Thereby in delusion-yoked though, at death-time knower falls not from self-truth.

param-p11-v96.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p11-v96.question: How Śiva at once?
premises: Truth-path this quickly when from teacher-mouth gains: by keen-grace-fall then indeed unblocked indeed Śiva.

param-p11-v97.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p11-v97.question: What at end?
premises: All-crossed form by step-stage-order resorting: on supreme-truth-rooting-gaining at end Śiva-made-ness.

param-p11-v98.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p11-v98.question: What if death mid-way?
premises: His truth-made stream ungone, middle-resting: that-step-gain-eager-minded though death sometime may be.

param-p11-v99.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p11-v99.question: What of fallen?
premises: Yoga-fallen in teaching called: wonder-enjoy-world-lord by rest-stage-power, become, in other birth becomes Śiva.

param-p11-v100.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p11-v100.question: What though missing?
premises: Truth-path this practising-not-gaining discipline though by name: god-world-pleasure-sharer glad-minded rejoices long.

param-p12-v101.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p12-v101.question: Who honored fallen?
premises: In objects emperor by all people honored as king: in worlds by all gods yoga-fallen so honored.

param-p12-v102.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p12-v102.question: How return?
premises: By long time again human-ness got, discipline practised: gets divine deathless whence turns not again.

param-p12-v103.speaker: Guru (teaching)
param-p12-v103.question: What strive?
premises: Therefore on true path herein devoted whoever goes he Śiva-ness: thus thought in truth yet strive.

param-p12-v104.speaker: Abhinavagupta (sealing)
param-p12-v104.question: How soon Śiva-ness?
premises: This Abhinavagupta-uttered-brief meditating supreme brahman: soon indeed Śiva-ness own-heart-entry comes.

param-p12-v105.speaker: Abhinavagupta (sealing)
param-p12-v105.question: Who condensed?
premises: By hundred-āryās this condensed teaching-essence recondite by Abhinavagupta, by me, by Śiva-feet-memory-kindled.

param-p01-v02.plain_english: Whirled in the sorrow-wheel from womb-dwelling to death-ending, the student asked the blessed Lord, the support: the supreme truth.

param-p01-v03.plain_english: By support-verses the teacher addressed its essence to him; Abhinavagupta tells it by Śiva-teaching-view-yoga.

param-p01-v04.plain_english: By own-power-glory-weight, this fourfold egg in division: power, Māyā, nature, earth — thus manifested by the Lord.

param-p01-v05.plain_english: Therein within, this universe is a varied body-faculty-world continuum; and therein the enjoyer, embodied, is Śiva indeed, fettered-state-taken.

param-p01-v06.plain_english: As the stainless crystal assumes the form of various sorts, so the Lord too holds god-man-beast-plant form-ness.

param-p01-v07.plain_english: As water moves and the moon-disc moves, as water stills so stillness goes: so this self, the great Lord, in the body-faculty-world mass.
param-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: gacchati gacchati jala iva himakarabimbaṃ sthite sthitiṃ yāti | tanukaraṇabhuvanavarge tathāyam ātmā maheśānaḥ

param-p01-v08.plain_english: As invisible Rahu, abiding on the moon-disc, shines, so the all-going self, by resorting to objects, shines in the mind-mirror.
param-p01-v08.sanskrit_cite: rāhur adṛśyo 'pi yathā śaśibimbasthaḥ prakāśate tadvat | sarvagato 'py ayam ātmā viṣayāśrayaṇena dhīmukure

param-p01-v09.plain_english: As a face shines in a dirt-free mirror, so this self shines, light-formed, in the mind-principle purified by Śiva's grace-descent.
param-p01-v09.sanskrit_cite: ādarśe malarahite yadvad vadanaṃ vibhāti tadvad ayam | śivaśaktipātavimale dhītattve bhāti bhārūpaḥ

param-p01-v10.plain_english: Light-formed, complete, great-bliss from resting in own self, filled by will, knowing and acting, endless-power-complete.
param-p01-v10.sanskrit_cite: bhārūpaṃ paripūrṇaṃ svātmani viśrāntito mahānandam | icchasaṃvitkaraṇair nirbharitam anantaśaktiparipūrṇam

param-p02-v11.plain_english: Free of every thought, pure, at peace, beyond rising and dissolving — in that supreme principle shines the world, thirty-six in nature.
param-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: sarvavikalpavihīnaṃ śuddhaṃ śāntaṃ layodayavihīnam | yat paratattvaṃ tasmin vibhāti ṣaṭṭriṃśadātma jagat

param-p02-v12.plain_english: As towns and villages, varied yet undivided in a mirror's orb, shine out in division, each from each and from the mirror too.
param-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: darpaṇabimbe yadvan nagaragrāmādicitram avibhāgi | bhāti vibhāgenaiva ca parasparaṃ darpaṇād api ca

param-p02-v13.plain_english: From the purest knowing of supreme Bhairava: though void of division, the world shines forth divided, each from each and thence.
param-p02-v13.sanskrit_cite: vimalatamaparamabhairavabodhāt tadvad vibhāgaśūnyam api | anyonyaṃ ca tato 'pi ca vibhaktam ābhāti jagad etat

param-p02-v14.plain_english: Śiva, power, Sadāśiva, then the Īśvara-Vidyā-formed principle-state — the five powers, in divided nature, He lights up.
param-p02-v14.sanskrit_cite: śivaśaktisadāśivatām īśvaravidyāmayīṃ ca tattvadaśām | śaktīnāṃ pañcānāṃ vibhaktabhāvena bhāsayati

param-p02-v15.plain_english: Supreme is the freedom that effects the hard thing, the great Lord's own; the goddess, Māyā-power, veils Śiva's self — that is it.
param-p02-v15.sanskrit_cite: paramaṃ yat svātantryaṃ durghaṭasaṃpādanaṃ maheśasya | devī māyāśaktiḥ svātmāvaraṇaṃ śivasya itat

param-p02-v16.plain_english: Grasped by Māyā, knowing turns stained and the person becomes a bound beast, fettered by time, art, limit, passion, ignorance.
param-p02-v16.sanskrit_cite: māyāparigrahavaśād bodho malinaḥ pumān paśur bhavati | kālakalāniyatibalād rāgāvidyāvaśena saṃbaddhaḥ

param-p02-v17.plain_english: Here and now I know but little, with my whole self: six sheaths with Māyā are the atom's inner limbs, so it is said.
param-p02-v17.sanskrit_cite: adhunaiva kiṃcid evedam eva sarvātmanaiva jānāmi | māyāsahitaṃ kañcukaṣaṭkam aṇor antaraṅgam idam uktam

param-p02-v18.plain_english: Like husk settled on rice-grain, separate yet undivided, purity comes by turning to Śiva's path with longing.
param-p02-v18.sanskrit_cite: kambukam iva ta.ṅdulakaṇaviniviṣṭaṃ bhinnam apy abhidā | bhajate tat tu viśuddhiṃ śivamārgaunmukhyayogena

param-p02-v19.plain_english: Mere pleasure, pain, delusion — from resolve, will, and I-sense; then nature, then the inner organ: intellect, mind, ego in turn.
param-p02-v19.sanskrit_cite: sukhaduḥkhamohamātraṃ niścayasaṃkalpanābhimānāc ca | prakṛtir athāntaḥkaranaṃ buddhimano'haṃkṛtikramaśaḥ

param-p03-v20.plain_english: Ear, skin, eye, tongue, nose — organs of knowing in sound and the rest; voice, hand, foot, anus, privates — organs of doing again.
param-p03-v20.sanskrit_cite: śrotraṃ tvagakṣirasanā ghrāṇaṃ buddhīndriyāṇi śabdādau | vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthaṃ karmendriyāṇi punaḥ

param-p03-v21.plain_english: Their object, to be grasped, is subtle and without divisions: the five tanmātras — sound, touch, form, taste, smell.
param-p03-v21.sanskrit_cite: eṣāṃ grāhyo viṣayaḥ sūkṣmaḥ pravibhāgavarjito yaḥ syāt | tanmātrapañcakaṃ tat śabdaḥ sparśo maho raso gandhaḥ

param-p03-v22.plain_english: From their mixture the gross object takes on five-element-ness: sky, wind, fire, water, and earth.
param-p03-v22.sanskrit_cite: etatsaṃsargavaśāt sthūlo viṣayas tu bhūtapañcakatām | abhyeti nabhaḥ pavanas tejaḥ salilaṃ ca pṛthvī ca

param-p03-v23.plain_english: As husk covers the rice-grain, creation beginning with nature covers; down to earth, consciousness wears the body.
param-p03-v23.sanskrit_cite: tuṣa iva ta.ṅdulakaṇikām āvṛṇute prakṛtipūrvakaḥ sargaḥ | pṛthvīparyanto 'yaṃ caitanyaṃ dehabhāvena

param-p03-v24.plain_english: The supreme covering! Impurity here: subtle — the Māyā-sheath; gross — the outer body-form; wrapped in three sheaths stands the self.
param-p03-v24.sanskrit_cite: param āvaraṇaṃ mala iha sūkṣmaṃ māyādikañcukaṃ sthūlam | bāhyaṃ vigraharūpaṃ kośatrayaveṣṭito hy ātmā

param-p03-v25.plain_english: Joined to darkness-ignorance, the one self, its own nature, perceives itself manifold through grasper-grasped variety.
param-p03-v25.sanskrit_cite: ajñānatimirayogād ekam api svaṃ svabhāvam ātmānam | grāhyagrāhakanānāvaicitryeṇāvabudhyeta

param-p03-v26.plain_english: As cane-juice in molasses, sugar, lumps: so every divided state of the supreme self, Śambhu.
param-p03-v26.sanskrit_cite: rasaphāṇitaśarkarikāguḍakha.ṅdādyā yathekṣurasa eva | tadvad avasthā bhedāḥ sarve paramātmanaḥ śambhoḥ

param-p03-v27.plain_english: Knower, inner ruler, breath, the all, the born — mere convention, in truth not at all.
param-p03-v27.sanskrit_cite: vijñānāntaryāmiprāṇavirāḍdehajātipi.ṅdāntāḥ | vyavahāramātram etat paramārthena tu na santy eva

param-p03-v28.plain_english: No snake in the rope, yet fear kills till death: delusion's great power no one can tell apart.
param-p03-v28.sanskrit_cite: rajjvāṃ nāsti bhujaṅgas trāsaṃ kurute ca mṛtyuparyantam | bhrānter mahatī śaktir na vivektuṃ śakyate nāma

param-p04-v29.plain_english: So dharma and adharma, heaven and hell, birth and death, pleasure and pain — caste, life-stage and the rest — though unreal in the self, arise by delusion's force.
param-p04-v29.sanskrit_cite: tadvad dharmādharmasvarnirayotpattimaraṇasukhaduḥkham | varṇāśramādi cātmany asad api vibhramabalād bhavati

param-p04-v30.plain_english: This is that darkness: shining in things, the conceit 'I am not the self' arises even where the self is unsurpassed.
param-p04-v30.sanskrit_cite: etat tad andhakāraṃ yad bhāveṣu prakāśamānatayā | ātmānatirikteṣv api bhavaty anātmābhimāno 'yam

param-p04-v31.plain_english: Darkness upon darkness — a great burst upon the cheek: taking body, breath and the rest, non-selves, for self.
param-p04-v31.sanskrit_cite: timirād api timiram idaṃ ga.ṅdasyopari mahān ayaṃ sphoṭaḥ | yad anātmany api dehaprāṇadāv ātmamānitvam

param-p04-v32.plain_english: By the yoga of body, breath, reflection, mind, knowing, and sky-expanse, the self wraps itself — a wonder — in a net, like the net-maker.
param-p04-v32.sanskrit_cite: dehaprāṇavimarśanadhījñānanabhaḥprapañcayogena | ātmānam veṣṭayate citraṃ jālena jālakāra iva

param-p04-v33.plain_english: By the yoga that shines with one's own knowing glory, unwrapping one's own self: thus supreme Śiva spreads the wondrous play of bondage and release.
param-p04-v33.sanskrit_cite: svajñānavibhavabhāsanayogenodveṣṭayen nijātmānam | iti bandhamokṣacitrāṃ krīḍāṃ pratanoti paramaśivaḥ

param-p04-v34.plain_english: Creating, keeping, dissolving; waking, dreaming, deep sleep — they shine in him, in the fourth abode, yet unveiled he shines.
param-p04-v34.sanskrit_cite: sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārā jāgratsvapnau suṣuptam iti tasmin | bhānti turīye dhāmani tathāpi tair nāvṛtaṃ bhāti

param-p04-v35.plain_english: Waking is the universe, through difference; dreaming is splendor, through light's glory; the knower is the sleep state, through massed knowing; beyond that, the fourth.
param-p04-v35.sanskrit_cite: jāgrad viśvaṃ bhedāt svapnas tejaḥ prakāśamāhātmyāt | prājñaḥ suptāvasthā jñānaghanatvāt tataḥ paraṃ turyam

param-p04-v36.plain_english: As cloud, smoke and dust do not soil the sky's surface, so the supreme person stands untouched by Māyā's deformings.
param-p04-v36.sanskrit_cite: jaladharadhūmarajobhir malinīkriyate yathā na gaganatalam | tadvan māyāvikṛtibhir aparāmṛṣṭaḥ paraḥ puruṣaḥ

param-p04-v37.plain_english: When one jar-sky is pervaded by dust, the others do not get soiled: so these souls, enjoying pleasure-pain differences.
param-p04-v37.sanskrit_cite: ekasmin ghaṭagagane rajasā vyāpte bhavanti nānyāni | malināni tadvad ete jīvāḥ sukhaduḥkhabhedajuṣaḥ

param-p05-v38.plain_english: In calm, calm; in glad, glad — so the fool is deluded; amid principles, the Lord is truly not so.
param-p05-v38.sanskrit_cite: śānte śānta ivāyaṃ hṛṣṭe hṛṣṭo vimohavati mūḍhaḥ | tattvagaṇe sati bhagavān na punaḥ paramārthataḥ sa tathā

param-p05-v39.plain_english: First removing the shining of that-form in non-self, the supreme self shatters delusion of the non-self-form in self.
param-p05-v39.sanskrit_cite: yad anātmany api tadrūpāvabhāsanaṃ tat purā nirākṛtya | ātmany anātmarūpāṃ bhrāntiṃ vidalayati paramātmā

param-p05-v40.plain_english: Thus, for one whose goal is gained in cutting delusion-pair at the root, no weighing of other duties ever, for the supreme yogin.
param-p05-v40.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ vibhramayugalakasamūlavicchedane kṛtārthasya | kartavyāntarakalanā na jātu parayogino bhavati

param-p05-v41.plain_english: Earth, nature, Māyā — this triad, fallen into known-form — by nondual-contemplation power becomes mere-being remainder.
param-p05-v41.sanskrit_cite: pṛthivī prakṛtir māyā tritayam idaṃ vedyarūpatāpatitam | advaitabhāvanabalād bhavati hi sanmātrapariśeṣam

param-p05-v42.plain_english: As girdle, earring, bracelet are seen as gold by leaving difference, so in leaving difference all shines as mere being.
param-p05-v42.sanskrit_cite: raśanāku.ṅdalakaṭakaṃ bhedatyāgena dṛśyate yathā hema | tadvad bhedatyāge sanmātraṃ sarvam ābhāti

param-p05-v43.plain_english: That brahman — supreme, pure, peaceful, nondual-natured, even, whole, deathless, true — rests in shining-formed power.
param-p05-v43.sanskrit_cite: tad brahma paraṃ śuddhaṃ śāntaṃ abhedātmakaṃ samaṃ sakalam | amṛtaṃ satyaṃ śaktau viśrāmyati bhāsvarūpāyām

param-p05-v44.plain_english: Desired, known, done — by the shining-formed: untouched, yet it takes sky-flower-ness.
param-p05-v44.sanskrit_cite: iṣyata iti vedyata iti saṃpādyata iti ca bhāsvarūpeṇa | aparāmṛṣṭaṃ yad api tu nabhaḥprasūnatvam abhyeti

param-p05-v45.plain_english: By grasp-yoga of power's trident, the whole, in the supreme Lord, in Śiva-name, in supreme truth, is emitted by god of gods.
param-p05-v45.sanskrit_cite: śaktitriśūlaparigamayogena samastam api parameśe | śivanāmani paramārthe visṛjyate devadevena

param-p05-v46.plain_english: Again too, by five-power-spreading order, outside, that varied egg-three created by outer-self-gaining.
param-p05-v46.sanskrit_cite: punar api ca pañcaśaktiprasaraṇakrameṇa bahir api tat | a.ṅdatrayaṃ vicitraṃ sṛṣṭaṃ bahirātmalābhena

param-p06-v47.plain_english: Thus driving, by play-discipline, the power-wheel-machine — god: I indeed, pure-formed, standing in the power-great-wheel-lord-seat.
param-p06-v47.sanskrit_cite: iti śakticakrayantraṃ krīḍāyogena vāhayan devaḥ | aham eva śuddharūpaḥ śaktimahācakranāyakapadasthaḥ

param-p06-v48.plain_english: In me indeed shines the universe, as jars and the like in a spotless mirror; from me spreads all, as dream-variety from a sleeper.
param-p06-v48.sanskrit_cite: mayy eva bhāti viśvaṃ darpaṇa iva nirmale ghatādīni | mattaḥ prasarati sarvaṃ svapnavicitratvam iva suptāt

param-p06-v49.plain_english: I indeed, universe-formed, hand-foot-and-all-natured as the body; in all I indeed shine, light-natured.
param-p06-v49.sanskrit_cite: aham eva viśvarūpaḥ karacaranādisvabhāva iva dehaḥ | sarvasmin aham eva sphurāmi bhāveṣu bhāsvarūpam iva

param-p06-v50.plain_english: Seer, hearer, smeller — bereft of body-senses though, a non-doer too: varied systems, texts, reasonings I indeed compose.
param-p06-v50.sanskrit_cite: draṣṭā śrotā ghrātā dehendriyavarjito 'py akartāpi | siddhāntāgamatarkāṃś citrān aham eva racayāmi

param-p06-v51.plain_english: Thus, duality-thought dissolved, crossing enchanting Māyā: as water in water, milk in milk — dissolved in brahman may one be.
param-p06-v51.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ dvaitavikalpe galite pravilaṅghya mohinīṃ māyām | salile salilaṃ kṣīre kṣīram iva brahmaṇi layī syāt

param-p06-v52.plain_english: Thus, in the principle-host, by contemplation attaining Śiva-madeness: what sorrow, what delusion, for the brahman-beholder?
param-p06-v52.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ tattvasamūhe bhāvanayā śivamayatvam abhiyāte | kaḥ śokaḥ ko mohaḥ sarvaṃ brahmāvalokayataḥ

param-p06-v53.plain_english: Deed-fruit, good or bad, comes only from contact with false knowing; hard indeed is contact's fault — like a thief's company, though one is no thief.
param-p06-v53.sanskrit_cite: karmaphalaṃ śubham aśubhaṃ mithyājñānena saṃgamād eva | viṣamo hi saṅgadoṣas taskarayogo 'py ataskarasyeva

param-p06-v54.plain_english: World-convention-makers who tend ignorance here, fools, go to birth and death, bound by duty's locks.
param-p06-v54.sanskrit_cite: lokavyavahārakṛtāṃ ya ihāvidyām upāsate mūḍhāḥ | te yānti janmamṛtyū dharmādharmārgalābaddhāḥ

param-p06-v55.plain_english: Yet even duty-formed deeds, heaped in ignorance-time, long-heaped like cotton, perish by knowing-flame-power.
param-p06-v55.sanskrit_cite: ajñānakālanicitaṃ dharmādharmātmakaṃ tu karmāpi | cirasaṃcitam iva tūlaṃ naśyati vijñānadīptivaśāt

param-p07-v56.plain_english: Done, yet not for fruit — how then birth? yoked to birth-bond gone, the Śiva-sun shines by its own rays.
param-p07-v56.sanskrit_cite: jñānaprāptau kṛtam api na phalāya tato 'sya janma katham | gatajanmabandhayogo bhāti śivārkaḥ svadīdhitibhiḥ

param-p07-v57.plain_english: As husk-cover-bran-freed seed makes no sprout, so the atom-Māyā-deed-freed self makes no birth-sprout.
param-p07-v57.sanskrit_cite: tuṣakambukakiṃśārukamuktaṃ bījaṃ yathāṅkuraṃ kurute | naiva tathāṇavamāyākarmavimukto bhavāṅkuraṃ hy ātmā

param-p07-v58.plain_english: The self-knower fears nowhere — all is his own form — and never grieves, since in truth there is no perishing.
param-p07-v58.sanskrit_cite: ātmajño na kutaścana bibheti sarvaṃ hi tasya nijarūpam | naiva ca śocati yasmāt paramārthe nāśitā nāsti

param-p07-v59.plain_english: From the supersecret heart-treasury's sprouted truth-jewel heap: 'I indeed' — in the great-Lord state, what misfortune, whose?
param-p07-v59.sanskrit_cite: atigūḍhahṛdayagañjaprarūḍhaparamārtharatnasaṃcayataḥ | aham eveti maheśvarabhāve kā durgatiḥ kasya

param-p07-v60.plain_english: Liberation has no abode at all, nor any going elsewhere: by cutting ignorance's knot, own-power-manifestation is liberation.
param-p07-v60.sanskrit_cite: mokṣasya naiva kiṃcid dhāmāsti na cāpi gamanam anyatra | ajñānagranthibhidā svaśaktyabhivyaktatā mokṣaḥ

param-p07-v61.plain_english: Cut-ignorance-knotted, doubt-gone, delusion-cast-off, merit-demerit-wasted — in body-yoked though, he is freed.
param-p07-v61.sanskrit_cite: bhinnājñānagranthir gatasaṃdehaḥ parākṛtabhrāntiḥ | prakṣīṇapuṇyapāpo vigrahayoge 'py asau muktaḥ

param-p07-v62.plain_english: As fire-inflamed seed loses sprout-power, so knowing-fire-burnt deed becomes birth-giving no more.
param-p07-v62.sanskrit_cite: agnyabhidagdhaṃ bījaṃ yathā prarohāsamarthatām eti | jñānāgnidagdham evaṃ karma na janmapradaṃ bhavati

param-p07-v63.plain_english: By limited-mind-ness, contemplating a body fit for its deeds, contracted knowing shines when this body falls.
param-p07-v63.sanskrit_cite: parimitabuddhitvena hi karmocitabhāvidehabhāvanayā | saṅkucitā citir etaddehadhvaṃse tathā bhāti

param-p07-v64.plain_english: If again stainless knowing — all-transcended-knower-doer-made, spread, light-formed never-setting-rising, true-resolved...
param-p07-v64.sanskrit_cite: yadi punar amalaṃ bodhaṃ sarvasamuttīrnaboddhṛkartṛmayam | vitatam anastamitoditabhārūpam satyasaṃkalpam

param-p08-v65.plain_english: Beyond direction-time-touch, firm, changeless, the full Lord — sole maker of hosts of powers dissolving and rising.

param-p08-v66.plain_english: Awakening to the self as Śiva-made, maker of creation's rules — how could he wander? Spread out, whence, where, what refuge?
param-p08-v66.sanskrit_cite: sṛṣṭyādividhisuvedhasam ātmānaṃ śivamayaṃ vibudhyeta | katham iva saṃsārī syād vitatasya kutaḥ kva vā saraṇam

param-p08-v67.plain_english: Thus proved by reasons: the knower's deed is fruitless. 'Not mine, this — but his': firmly, no fruit in the world.
param-p08-v67.sanskrit_cite: iti yuktibhir api siddhaṃ yatkarma jñānino na saphalaṃ tat | na mamedam api tu tasyeti dārḍhyato na hi phalaṃ loke

param-p08-v68.plain_english: Thus awakened by contemplation-wind, sacrificing all thoughts in the blazing self-flame, he becomes flame.
param-p08-v68.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ sakalavikalpān pratibuddho bhāvanāsamīraṇataḥ | ātmajyotiṣi dīpte juhvaj jyotirmayo bhavati

param-p08-v69.plain_english: Eating this or that, covered by anything, calmed, dwelling anywhere — the all-beings-self is freed.
param-p08-v69.sanskrit_cite: aśnan yad vā tad vā saṃvīto yena kenacic chāntaḥ | yatra kvacana nivāsī vimucyate sarvabhūtātmā

param-p08-v70.plain_english: Though doing horse-rites by hundred-thousands, brahmin-killings by hundred-thousands — the truth-knower, by merits not, by faults not touched, stainless.
param-p08-v70.sanskrit_cite: hayamedhaśatasahasrāṇy api kurute brahmaghātalakṣāṇi | paramārthavin na puṇyair na ca pāpaiḥ spṛśyate vimalaḥ

param-p08-v71.plain_english: Leaving pride, joy, anger, lust, sorrow, fear, greed, delusion; no praise, no formula; dull as if — let him move, opinion-free.

param-p08-v72.plain_english: The pride-joy host arises from difference-delusion: how could the nondual-self-awakened be touched by it?
param-p08-v72.sanskrit_cite: madaharṣaprabhṛtir ayaṃ vargaḥ prabhavati vibhedasaṃmohāt | advaitātmavibodhas tena kathaṃ spṛśyatāṃ nāma

param-p08-v73.plain_english: Nothing to praise or offer, separate from him, at all: pleased by praise, freed — then no bow, no formula.
param-p08-v73.sanskrit_cite: stutyaṃ vā hotavyaṃ nāsti vyatiriktam asya kiṃcana ca | stotrādinā sa tuṣyen muktas tan nirnamaskṛtivaṣaṭkaḥ

param-p09-v74.plain_english: Bearing thirty-six principles, full-eyed in body-making: own or other's body, jar and the like — his god-house.
param-p09-v74.sanskrit_cite: ṣaṭtriṃśattattvabhṛtaṃ vigraharacanāgavākṣaparipūrṇam | nijam anyad atha śarīraṃ ghaṭādi vā tasya devagṛham

param-p09-v75.plain_english: There the supreme-self-great-Bhairava-Śiva-goddess, yoked to own power, sits worshipped with self-grasped pure gifts.
param-p09-v75.sanskrit_cite: tatra ca paramātmamahābhairavaśivadevatāṃ svaśaktiyutām | ātmāmarśanavimaladravyaiḥ paripūjayann āste

param-p09-v76.plain_english: Offering the great seed-heap of outer-inner-fancied difference in his blazing knowing-fire — effortless the offering.
param-p09-v76.sanskrit_cite: bahirantaraparikalpanabhedamahābījanicayam arpayataḥ | tasyātidīptasaṃvijjvalane yatnād vinā bhavati homaḥ

param-p09-v77.plain_english: Meditation never setting: the blessed Lord creates varied forms — that itself is meditation, true-formed as fancy draws.
param-p09-v77.sanskrit_cite: dhyānam anastamitaṃ punar eṣa hi bhagavān vicitrarūpāṇi | sṛjati tad eva dhyānaṃ saṃkalpālikhitasatyarūpatvam

param-p09-v78.plain_english: Turning world-rows, principle-order-fancies, sense-hosts in inner knowing — that, they say, is his muttering.
param-p09-v78.sanskrit_cite: bhuvanāvalīṃ samastāṃ tattvakramakalpanām athākṣagaṇam | antarbodhe parivartayati ca yat so 'sya japa uditaḥ

param-p09-v79.plain_english: Seeing all with an even glance, deeming knowing content, delighting in the world-burning-ground, grasping the body as skull-staff.
param-p09-v79.sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ samayā dṛṣṭyā yat paśyati yac ca saṃvidaṃ manute | viśvaśmaśānaniratāṃ vigrahakhaṭvāṅgakalpanākalitām

param-p09-v80.plain_english: Tasting the world-essence-drink-filled, own-hand-held, known-fragment bowl — this vow, hard to get and easy to get.
param-p09-v80.sanskrit_cite: viśvarasāsavapūrṇaṃ nijakaragaṃ vedyakha.ṅdakakapālam | rasayati ca yat tad etad vratam asya sudurlabhaṃ ca sulabhaṃ ca

param-p09-v81.plain_english: Thus birth-death-free, named truth-great-Lord, having got — by the finder's shining, done-done, standing as wished.
param-p09-v81.sanskrit_cite: iti janmanāśahīnaṃ paramārthamaheśvarākhyam upalabhya | upalabdhṛtāprakāśāt kṛtakṛtyas tiṣṭhati yatheṣṭam

param-p09-v82.plain_english: Pervading, so told, all-self, diversity-shaken, peerless bliss supreme: who knows becomes made of that.
param-p09-v82.sanskrit_cite: vyāpinam abhihitam itthaṃ sarvātmānaṃ vidhūtanānātvam | nirupamaparamānandaṃ yo vetti sa tanmayo bhavati

param-p10-v83.plain_english: In a shrine or an outcaste hut, memory lost though, abandoning the body — freed simultaneous with knowing, going to isolation, sorrow killed.
param-p10-v83.sanskrit_cite: tīrthe śvapacagṛhe vā naṣṭasmṛtir api parityajan deham | jñānasamakālamuktaḥ kaivalyaṃ yāti hataśokaḥ

param-p10-v84.plain_english: Shrine-service for merit, outcaste-death for hell — but with no touch of merit-demerit stain, what use?
param-p10-v84.sanskrit_cite: puṇyāya tīrthasevā nirayāya śvapacasadananidhanagatiḥ | puṇyāpuṇyakalaṅkasparśābhāve tu kiṃ tena

param-p10-v85.plain_english: Throwing the well-separated rice-grain between husk-pieces makes not again that-form identity.

param-p10-v86.plain_english: So the sheath-curtain-separated knowing, here by impression, standing though — freed self, untouched by that touch, becomes.
param-p10-v86.sanskrit_cite: tadvat kañcukapaṭalīpṛthakkṛtā saṃvid atra saṃskārāt | tiṣṭhanty api muktātmā tatsparśavivarjitā bhavati

param-p10-v87.plain_english: As flawless-made by the best artisan, the casket-bound gem, though stained, on cutting the bound shows clear truth.
param-p10-v87.sanskrit_cite: kuśalatamaśilpikalpitavimalībhāvaḥ samudgakopādheḥ | malino 'pi maṇir upādher vicchede svacchaparamārthaḥ

param-p10-v88.plain_english: So the true-teacher-taught pure state, feeling the body-bound, freed though void of other bounds, shines as Śiva-formed.
param-p10-v88.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ sadguruśāsanavimalasthiti vedanaṃ tanūpādheḥ | muktam apy upādhyantaraśūnyam ivābhāti śivarūpam

param-p10-v89.plain_english: By scripture's weight, by unshaken faith become that — got before heaven, hell, man-ness.
param-p10-v89.sanskrit_cite: śāstrādiprāmāṇyād avicalitaśraddhayāpi tanmayatām | prāptaḥ sa eva pūrvaṃ svargaṃ narakaṃ manuṣyatvam

param-p10-v90.plain_english: The last moment, nourishing a merit or demerit state, plays helper — but in going on, no cause.
param-p10-v90.sanskrit_cite: antyaḥ kṣaṇas tu tasmin puṇyāṃ pāpāṃ ca vā sthitiṃ puṣyan | mūḍhānāṃ sahakārībhāvaṃ gacchati gatau tu na sa hetuḥ

param-p10-v91.plain_english: Whoever knows that-self-ness — beast, bird, creeper and the rest — goes his own way, by old awakening impressed.
param-p10-v91.sanskrit_cite: ye 'pi tadātmatvena viduḥ paśupakṣisarīsṛpādayaḥ svagatim | te 'pi purātanasaṃbodhasaṃskṛtās tāṃ gatiṃ yānti

param-p11-v92.plain_english: Heaven-made, hell-made — this person between bodies; when that breaks, by fitness joining another body.
param-p11-v92.sanskrit_cite: svargamayo nirayamayas tad ayaṃ dehāntarālagaḥ puruṣaḥ | tadbhaṅge svaucityād dehāntarayogam abhyeti

param-p11-v93.plain_english: As in knowing-time the self once shone for him, so then — on body-falling, otherwise it does not become.
param-p11-v93.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ jñānāvasare svātmā sakṛd asya yādṛg avabhātaḥ | tādṛśa eva tadāsau na dehapāte 'nyathā bhavati

param-p11-v94.plain_english: Senses stolen, memory lost, breath choked, cut off, vitals pained — enjoyment born of body-impressions.
param-p11-v94.sanskrit_cite: karaṇagaṇasaṃpramoṣaḥ smṛtināśaḥ śvāsakalilatā cchedaḥ | marmasu rujāviśeṣāḥ śarīrasaṃskārajo bhogaḥ

param-p11-v95.plain_english: How could he, being embodied, not be so? By that, deluded though — at death-time the knower falls not from self-truth.
param-p11-v95.sanskrit_cite: sa kathaṃ vigrahayoge sati na bhavet tena mohayoge 'pi | maraṇāvasare jñāni na cyavate svātmaparamārthāt

param-p11-v96.plain_english: This truth-path, quickly, when gained from the teacher's mouth — by keenest grace-fall, then indeed, unblocked, Śiva.
param-p11-v96.sanskrit_cite: paramārthamārgam enaṃ jhaṭiti yadā gurumukhāt samabhyeti | atitīvraśaktipātāt tadaiva nirvighnam eva śivaḥ

param-p11-v97.plain_english: All-crossed form, by steps resorted, on gaining root in supreme truth — at the end, Śiva-madeness.
param-p11-v97.sanskrit_cite: sarvottīrṇaṃ rūpaṃ sopānapadakrameṇa saṃśrayataḥ | paratattvarūḍhilābhe paryante śivamayībhāvaḥ

param-p11-v98.plain_english: But his truth-made stream, unreached, middle-rested — though mind yearns for that step, death may sometime come.
param-p11-v98.sanskrit_cite: tasya tu paramārthamayīṃ dhārām agatasya madhyaviśrānteḥ | tatpadalābhotsukacetaso 'pi maraṇaṃ kadācit syāt

param-p11-v99.plain_english: Fallen from yoga, the books call him wonder-enjoyment-world-lord; rested by stage-power, become, in next birth Śiva-becoming.
param-p11-v99.sanskrit_cite: yogabhraṣṭaḥ śāstre kathito 'sau citrabhogabhuvanapatiḥ | viśrāntisthānavaśād bhūtvā janmāntare śivībhavati

param-p11-v100.plain_english: Practising this truth-path, missing yoga though, by name — god-world-pleasure-sharer, glad-minded, rejoices long.
param-p11-v100.sanskrit_cite: paramārthamārgam enaṃ hy abhyasyāprāpya yogam api nāma | suralokabhogabhāgī muditamanā modate suciram

param-p12-v101.plain_english: As an emperor among things is honored by all people as king, so among worlds the yoga-fallen is honored by all gods.
param-p12-v101.sanskrit_cite: viṣayeṣu sārvabhaumaḥ sarvajanaiḥ pūjyate yathā rājā | bhuvaneṣu sarvadaivair yogabhraṣṭas tathā pūjyaḥ

param-p12-v102.plain_english: After long time, humanity got, yoga practised — getting the divine deathless whence turning back no more.
param-p12-v102.sanskrit_cite: mahatā kālena punar mānuṣyaṃ prāpya yogam abhyasya | prāpnoti divyam amṛtam yasmād āvartate na punaḥ

param-p12-v103.plain_english: Therefore whoever, devoted on the true path here, goes — he to Śiva-ness: thinking so, in truth yet strive.
param-p12-v103.sanskrit_cite: tasmāt sanmārge 'smin nirato yaḥ kaścid eti sa śivatvam | iti matvā paramārthe yathā tathāpi prayatanīyam

param-p12-v104.plain_english: Meditating this supreme brahman, briefly told by Abhinavagupta — soon indeed Śiva-ness enters own-heart-dwelling.
param-p12-v104.sanskrit_cite: idam abhinavaguptoditasaṃkṣepaṃ dhyāyataḥ paraṃ brahma | acirād eva śivatvaṃ nijahṛdayāveśam abhyeti

param-p12-v105.plain_english: In a hundred āryās this condensed recondite teaching-essence — by Abhinavagupta, by me, kindled by Śiva-feet-memory.
param-p12-v105.sanskrit_cite: āryāśatena tad idaṃ saṃkṣiptaṃ śāstrasāram atigūḍham | abhinavaguptena mayā śivacaraṇasmaraṇadīptena

essence: Refuge in all-abiding Śambhu; whirled student asks, teacher answers in verses.
Fourfold egg manifested by Lord's power-weight; enjoyer embodied is Śiva fettered.
Lord holds all forms as crystal takes colors; self moves/rests with world-mass.
Everywhere-self shines in mind-mirror; grace-pure mind mirrors light-formed self, will-knowing-acting replete.

sections.SUMMARY: I resort to all-abiding Śambhu. The sorrow-wheel-whirled student asks the supreme truth; the teacher answers in support-verses, retold Śaiva-wise. The Lord manifests the fourfold egg by power-weight; the embodied enjoyer is Śiva fettered. As crystal takes colors the Lord holds all forms; as moon moves with water the self moves with the world. As Rahu shows on the moon the everywhere-self shows in the mind-mirror; grace-purified mind mirrors the light-formed self, replete with will, knowing and acting.

rasa.justification: Opening refuge (bhakti) settling into taught peace (śānta): invoked, asked, answered.

essence: Thought-free principle shines the thirty-six like mirror-towns; freedom effects the hard, Māyā veils; grasped knowing stains sixfold; the atom knows little now; husk-separate yet one, purified by path; mere proceedings ordered.

sections.SUMMARY: The supreme principle, free of thought, pure and at peace, shines the thirty-six-fold world as towns shine in a mirror — undivided yet divided, lit by the five powers in divided nature. Supreme freedom effects what is hard; Māyā-power veils Śiva's self. Grasped knowing stains and the person turns beast, sixfold fettered; the atom knows but little here and now, six-sheathed within. As husk on rice, separate yet one, purity comes by the Śiva path; mere pleasure-pain-delusion proceeds from resolve into the ordered inner organ.

rasa.justification: Doctrinal enumeration settling into peace: tattvas, organs, elements told in order.

essence: Five knowing, five doing organs; subtle division-free objects; mixture grossifies; creation husks consciousness; three sheaths wrap; one self manifold-perceived; one juice many sweets; selves conventional; delusion undiscriminable.

sections.SUMMARY: Ear to nose know, voice to privates do; their objects are subtle and division-free tanmātras, whose mixture grossifies into five elements. Creation from nature husks consciousness down to earth; three sheaths wrap the self. Through ignorance-darkness the one self perceives manifold grasper-grasped variety — as one cane-juice in many sweets, all states of Śambhu. Knower, ruler, breath and the rest are mere convention; rope-snake fear kills, and delusion's power none can tell apart.

rasa.justification: Doctrinal enumeration settling into peace: tattvas, organs, elements told in order.

essence: Unreal orders arise by delusion; shining-things darkness takes non-self for self, burst upon burst; self nets itself spider-like; unwrapped, supreme Śiva spreads bondage-release play; states shine in the fourth unveiled; three states told, fourth beyond; sky unsoiled, jars unsoiled.

sections.SUMMARY: So dharma through pain, caste through stations, though unreal in the self, arise by delusion's force. This is that darkness: shining in things, the not-self is taken for self — darkness upon darkness, a burst upon the cheek, body and breath taken for self. By body-breath-reflection yoga the self wraps itself in a net like the net-maker; unwrapped by its own shining glory, supreme Śiva spreads the play of bondage and release. Creating, waking, sleep shine in the fourth, yet unveiled. Waking is difference-universe, dreaming is light-glory, sleep is massed knowing — beyond, the fourth. As sky unsoiled by cloud-smoke-dust, the person untouched by Māyā; as one dusty jar leaves others clean, souls enjoy differences unstained.

rasa.dominant: karuṇa-śānta of bondage shown and dissolved
rasa.justification: Darkness pitied, unwrapping stillness: net shown, play spread, gold seen.

essence: Seeming follows states, Lord truly not; mirroring removed, delusion shattered; rooted done, no duty; triad remainders into being; difference left, being shines; brahman rests in power; untouched sky-flowered; all emitted in Śiva-name; three eggs created.

sections.SUMMARY: In calm calm, in glad glad — the fool follows states, but the Lord truly not so. First the non-self's mirroring removed, then self's non-self delusion shattered. Root-cut, done-done, no further duty for the supreme yogin. Earth-nature-Māyā remainder into mere being by nondual might; as goldsmith's wares are gold when difference is left, all shines as being. Brahman rests in shining power; untouched, yet sky-flowered. All emitted in Śiva-name by god of gods; again the varied three eggs created outwardly.

rasa.dominant: karuṇa-śānta of bondage shown and dissolved
rasa.justification: Darkness pitied, unwrapping stillness: net shown, play spread, gold seen.

essence: I drive the play-wheel pure-formed; in-me shining, from-me spreading; universe-formed shining in all; senseless seer composing systems; crossed Māyā dissolved as water-in-water; Śiva-made beyond sorrow; fruits from contact, company hard; fools cycle bound; heaped deeds burn as cotton.

sections.SUMMARY: Thus driving the power-wheel-machine by play, I stand pure-formed in the lord-seat. In me shines the universe as jars in a spotless mirror; from me spreads all as dreams from a sleeper. Universe-formed, hand-foot-natured as body, I shine in all, light-natured. Seer, hearer, smeller, senseless, undoing, I compose varied systems. Duality dissolved, Māyā crossed — dissolved in brahman as water in water, milk in milk. Principle-host contemplated into Śiva-madeness: what sorrow for the brahman-beholder? Fruits come from contact with false knowing; company faults hard, like a thief's though one is no thief. Convention-tending fools cycle duty-bound; ignorance-heaped deeds burn like cotton in knowing-flame.

rasa.justification: I-voice exulting: driving, shining, composing, freed.

essence: Done fruitless ends birth; freed seed unsprouting; own-formed all fearless griefless; jewel-heaped I-Lord misfortune-free; no-abode no-journey knot-cut manifestation; knotted cut freed though bodied; burnt seed unbirthing deed; limited mind contracts knowing to body; stainless vow stated.

sections.SUMMARY: Done yet fruitless — how birth? Birth-bond gone, the Śiva-sun shines by its own rays. As husk-freed seed unsprouting, the freed self unbirthing. All own-formed: fearless, griefless, since perishing is not. Jewel-heaped from the heart-treasury — 'I indeed' in the Lord-state: what misfortune? Liberation has no abode, no journey: knot-cut, own-power-manifest. Knotted cut, doubted gone, delusion cast, merit wasted — bodied yet freed. As burnt seed unsprouting, burnt deed unbirthing. Limited mind, contemplating fit bodies, contracts knowing to the falling body. If again stainless knowing, all-transcending, spread, never-setting light-formed, true-resolved...

rasa.justification: I-voice exulting: driving, shining, composing, freed.

essence: Beyond touch firm Lord hosts-making; Śiva-made awakened wanders not; not-mine affirmed fruitless; thoughts sacrificed flame-become; covered calmed anywhere freed; extremes done untouched; dull-moving opinion-free; delusion-host touches not; nothing separate praise-needless.

sections.SUMMARY: Beyond direction-time-touch, firm, changeless, full Lord, sole maker of dissolving-rising hosts. Awakened to self as Śiva-made, rule-maker: how wander, spread out? Proved: the knower's deed fruitless — 'not mine but his,' firmly. Thoughts sacrificed in blazing self-flame: flame-become. Eating anything, covered, calmed, anywhere: freed. Extremes done, untouched by merit-fault, stainless. Stainless, formulaless, dull-moving, opinion-free. Difference-born host touches not the nondual-awakened. Nothing separate to praise or offer: pleased, freed, bowless.

essence: Bodied temple god-housed; Bhairavī worshipped with pure gifts; difference-seeds offered effortless; creating is meditating; worlds turned inward muttering; even-glanced burning-ground body; skull-bowl tasted hard-easy; got truth done-done standing; knowing told all-self made-of-that.

sections.SUMMARY: Thirty-six-bearing, body-eyed, own or other's — his god-house. Bhairavī worshipped there with self-grasped pure gifts. Difference-seeds offered in blazing knowing-fire, effortless. Never-setting meditation: creating varied forms, fancy-drawn true. Worlds turned inward: muttering. Even-glanced, burning-ground-delighting, skull-staff-grasped. Skull-bowl tasted: hard-easy vow. Got birth-death-free truth: done-done standing as wished. Told pervading all-self, peerless bliss: knowing becomes that.

essence: Place-indifferent dying goes isolation; rites useless to stainless; separated unrejoined; staying though touch-free; condition cut gem-clear; teacher-purified Śiva-formed; faith-got before fates; moment helper not cause; beast-knowing goes right.

sections.SUMMARY: Dying in shrine or hut, memory or not — freed with knowing, going to isolation, sorrow killed. Rites for merit or hell mean nothing to the stain-untouched. Separated grain unrejoined; separated knowing, staying, touch-free. Condition cut: gem-clear. Teacher-purified, Śiva-formed. Faith-made before heaven-hell-man. The last moment helps fools, causes nothing. Beast-knowing goes right by old awakening.

rasa.dominant: śānta of death faced and succession assured
rasa.justification: Dying well, falling well, returning well: peace.

essence: Between-bodies fit-yoked; once-shone stays same; death-signs listed; yoked yet unfallen; taught quickly Śiva at once; stepped resorting ends Śiva-made; mid-way death allowed; fallen rests returns Śiva; missing yet rejoicing.

sections.SUMMARY: Heaven-hell-made, between bodies, fitness-yoked onward. Once-shone in knowing-time stays same past body-fall. Death-signs: senses stolen, memory lost, breath choked. Yoked yet unfallen from self-truth. Taught quickly from teacher-mouth: keen-graced, unblocked Śiva. Stepped resorting roots in truth, ends Śiva-made. Mid-way death allowed the yearning. Fallen rests a world-lord, returns Śiva next birth. Missing yoga yet rejoicing long in god-pleasures.

rasa.dominant: śānta of death faced and succession assured
rasa.justification: Dying well, falling well, returning well: peace.

essence: Fallen honored as king; long-returned getting deathless; devoted going yet striving; meditated brief soon entering; hundred-verse essence sealed by feet-kindled me.

sections.SUMMARY: As emperors are honored, so the fallen yogin among gods. After long time, humanity regained, yoga practised — the deathless got, no return. Whoever devoted on the true path goes to Śiva-ness: think so, yet strive. Meditating the brief-told supreme brahman, soon Śiva-ness enters own-heart-dwelling. In a hundred āryās this recondite essence condensed — by Abhinavagupta, by me, kindled by Śiva-feet-memory.

lines: Supreme, abiding beyond, depthless, beginningless, one,
lodged in many caves, home of all: Śambhu, to You I come for refuge.
param-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: paraṃ parasthaṃ gahanād anādim | sarvālayaṃ sarvacarācarasthaṃ tvām eva śambhuṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye

lines: Whirled from womb dwelling to death's end on sorrow's wheel,
the student asked the blessed Lord, the prop: the highest truth.
In support verses the teacher spoke its pith to him;
Abhinavagupta tells it in Śiva's teaching view.
param-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: ādhārakārikābhiḥ taṃ gurur abhibhāṣati sma tatsāram | kathayaty abhinavaguptaḥ śivaśāsanadṛṣṭiyogena

lines: From the weight of his own power's glory, the fourfold egg divided:
power, Māyā, nature, earth, so the Lord displayed.
param-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: nijaśaktivaibhavabharād a.ṅdacatuṣṭayam idaṃ vibhāgena | śaktir māyā prakṛtiḥ pṛthvī ceti prabhāvitaṃ prabhuṇā

lines: There within lies the world, a skein of varied bodies, senses, worlds;
and there the enjoyer, embodied, Śiva himself, wearing the beast.
param-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: tatrāntar viśvam idaṃ vicitratanukaraṇabhuvanasaṃtānam | bhoktā ca tatra dehī śiva eva gṛhītapaśubhāvaḥ

lines: As stainless crystal takes all colors for its own,
so the Lord wears every form, of god and man and beast and plant.
param-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: nānāvidhavarṇānāṃ rūpaṃ dhatte yathāmalaḥ sphaṭikaḥ | suramānuṣapaśupādaparūpatvaṃ tadvad īśo 'pi

lines: When waters run, the moon runs; when waters still, stillness:
so this self, great Lord, in the mass of bodies, senses, worlds.
param-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: gacchati gacchati jala iva himakarabimbaṃ sthite sthitiṃ yāti | tanukaraṇabhuvanavarge tathāyam ātmā maheśānaḥ

lines: As unseen Rahu, standing on the moon, shines forth,
so the all pervading self, through sense things, shines in mind's mirror.
param-p01-v08.sanskrit_cite: rāhur adṛśyo 'pi yathā śaśibimbasthaḥ prakāśate tadvat | sarvagato 'py ayam ātmā viṣayāśrayaṇena dhīmukure

lines: As a face shines in a stainless mirror,
so the self is light itself, in a mind made pure by Śiva's falling grace.
param-p01-v09.sanskrit_cite: ādarśe malarahite yadvad vadanaṃ vibhāti tadvad ayam | śivaśaktipātavimale dhītattve bhāti bhārūpaḥ

lines: Formed of light, whole, at rest in self, in bliss profound,
brimmed with will and knowing and doing, powers without end.
param-p01-v10.sanskrit_cite: bhārūpaṃ paripūrṇaṃ svātmani viśrāntito mahānandam | icchasaṃvitkaraṇair nirbharitam anantaśaktiparipūrṇam

lines: Thoughtless, pure, at peace, past rising and setting,
the highest truth holds the world of thirty six within.
param-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: sarvavikalpavihīnaṃ śuddhaṃ śāntaṃ layodayavihīnam | yat paratattvaṃ tasmin vibhāti ṣaṭṭriṃśadātma jagat

lines: Towns and villages, many yet undivided in the mirror,
shine divided, each from each, and from the mirror too.
param-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: darpaṇabimbe yadvan nagaragrāmādicitram avibhāgi | bhāti vibhāgenaiva ca parasparaṃ darpaṇād api ca

lines: From purest Bhairava knowing, though divisionless,
the world shines out divided, each from each, from that.
param-p02-v13.sanskrit_cite: vimalatamaparamabhairavabodhāt tadvad vibhāgaśūnyam api | anyonyaṃ ca tato 'pi ca vibhaktam ābhāti jagad etat

lines: Siva, power, Sadashiva, then the Lord and Wisdom state,
the five powers in divided nature he lights.
param-p02-v14.sanskrit_cite: śivaśaktisadāśivatām īśvaravidyāmayīṃ ca tattvadaśām | śaktīnāṃ pañcānāṃ vibhaktabhāvena bhāsayati

lines: Supreme the freedom that works the impossible, the great Lord's,
while Maya power, the goddess, veils Siva's self.
param-p02-v15.sanskrit_cite: paramaṃ yat svātantryaṃ durghaṭasaṃpādanaṃ maheśasya | devī māyāśaktiḥ svātmāvaraṇaṃ śivasya itat

lines: Caught by Maya, knowing stains, the person turns to beast,
bound by time and art and limit, passion, ignorance.
param-p02-v16.sanskrit_cite: māyāparigrahavaśād bodho malinaḥ pumān paśur bhavati | kālakalāniyatibalād rāgāvidyāvaśena saṃbaddhaḥ

lines: Here and now I know so little, with my whole self:
six sheaths with Maya are the atom's inward limbs, they say.
param-p02-v17.sanskrit_cite: adhunaiva kiṃcid evedam eva sarvātmanaiva jānāmi | māyāsahitaṃ kañcukaṣaṭkam aṇor antaraṅgam idam uktam

lines: As husk that clings to rice yet stands apart,
purity comes by turning toward Siva's path with longing.
param-p02-v18.sanskrit_cite: kambukam iva ta.ṅdulakaṇaviniviṣṭaṃ bhinnam apy abhidā | bhajate tat tu viśuddhiṃ śivamārgaunmukhyayogena

lines: Pleasure, pain, delusion, mere ripples of resolve,
then nature, then within: intellect, mind, and I sense in turn.
param-p02-v19.sanskrit_cite: sukhaduḥkhamohamātraṃ niścayasaṃkalpanābhimānāc ca | prakṛtir athāntaḥkaranaṃ buddhimano'haṃkṛtikramaśaḥ

lines: Ear, skin, eye, tongue, nose, to know the world of sound,
voice, hand, foot and the rest, to work it out again.
param-p03-v20.sanskrit_cite: śrotraṃ tvagakṣirasanā ghrāṇaṃ buddhīndriyāṇi śabdādau | vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthaṃ karmendriyāṇi punaḥ

lines: Subtle, partless, theirs to grasp: the five fine essences,
sound and touch and form and taste and smell.
param-p03-v21.sanskrit_cite: eṣāṃ grāhyo viṣayaḥ sūkṣmaḥ pravibhāgavarjito yaḥ syāt | tanmātrapañcakaṃ tat śabdaḥ sparśo maho raso gandhaḥ

lines: Mixed together they grow gross, five elements they turn:
sky and wind and fire and water and earth.
param-p03-v22.sanskrit_cite: etatsaṃsargavaśāt sthūlo viṣayas tu bhūtapañcakatām | abhyeti nabhaḥ pavanas tejaḥ salilaṃ ca pṛthvī ca

lines: As husk hides rice, so creation hides the light from earth,
and consciousness puts on the body like a robe.
param-p03-v23.sanskrit_cite: tuṣa iva ta.ṅdulakaṇikām āvṛṇute prakṛtipūrvakaḥ sargaḥ | pṛthvīparyanto 'yaṃ caitanyaṃ dehabhāvena

lines: O the covering! Stain within: the subtle Maya sheath without,
the gross outer body. Threefold wrapped, the self stands.
param-p03-v24.sanskrit_cite: param āvaraṇaṃ mala iha sūkṣmaṃ māyādikañcukaṃ sthūlam | bāhyaṃ vigraharūpaṃ kośatrayaveṣṭito hy ātmā

lines: Wed to darkness, the one self sees its own face manifold,
splintered through seer and seen in every kind.
param-p03-v25.sanskrit_cite: ajñānatimirayogād ekam api svaṃ svabhāvam ātmānam | grāhyagrāhakanānāvaicitryeṇāvabudhyeta

lines: As cane juice lives in syrup, sugar, lump,
so every broken state lives in highest Sambhu.
param-p03-v26.sanskrit_cite: rasaphāṇitaśarkarikāguḍakha.ṅdādyā yathekṣurasa eva | tadvad avasthā bhedāḥ sarve paramātmanaḥ śambhoḥ

lines: Knower, ruler within, breath, the all, the born,
mere names of common use, in truth not at all.
param-p03-v27.sanskrit_cite: vijñānāntaryāmiprāṇavirāḍdehajātipi.ṅdāntāḥ | vyavahāramātram etat paramārthena tu na santy eva

lines: No snake in the rope, yet fear kills to the end of death.
Such is delusion's power, past all telling apart.
param-p03-v28.sanskrit_cite: rajjvāṃ nāsti bhujaṅgas trāsaṃ kurute ca mṛtyuparyantam | bhrānter mahatī śaktir na vivektuṃ śakyate nāma

lines: Right and wrong, heaven and hell, birth and death, joy and pain,
rank and station, unreal in self, rise by delusion's force.
param-p04-v29.sanskrit_cite: tadvad dharmādharmasvarnirayotpattimaraṇasukhaduḥkham | varṇāśramādi cātmany asad api vibhramabalād bhavati

lines: This is that darkness: shining in things, the thought arrives,
I am not the self, even where self was never surpassed.
param-p04-v30.sanskrit_cite: etat tad andhakāraṃ yad bhāveṣu prakāśamānatayā | ātmānatirikteṣv api bhavaty anātmābhimāno 'yam

lines: Dark on dark, a great welt on the cheek:
taking body and breath, not selves, for self.
param-p04-v31.sanskrit_cite: timirād api timiram idaṃ ga.ṅdasyopari mahān ayaṃ sphoṭaḥ | yad anātmany api dehaprāṇadāv ātmamānitvam

lines: With body, breath, thought, mind, knowing, open sky,
the self nets itself, a wonder, as the spider does.
param-p04-v32.sanskrit_cite: dehaprāṇavimarśanadhījñānanabhaḥprapañcayogena | ātmānam veṣṭayate citraṃ jālena jālakāra iva

lines: Shining with its own knowing glory, unwrapped itself:
so highest Siva spreads the bright play of bound and free.
param-p04-v33.sanskrit_cite: svajñānavibhavabhāsanayogenodveṣṭayen nijātmānam | iti bandhamokṣacitrāṃ krīḍāṃ pratanoti paramaśivaḥ

lines: Making, keeping, loosing, waking, dreaming, deep asleep,
they shine in him, in the fourth room, yet unveiled he shines.
param-p04-v34.sanskrit_cite: sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārā jāgratsvapnau suṣuptam iti tasmin | bhānti turīye dhāmani tathāpi tair nāvṛtaṃ bhāti

lines: Waking is the world through difference, dream through splendor of light,
deep sleep the knower massed in knowing, and past that, the fourth.
param-p04-v35.sanskrit_cite: jāgrad viśvaṃ bhedāt svapnas tejaḥ prakāśamāhātmyāt | prājñaḥ suptāvasthā jñānaghanatvāt tataḥ paraṃ turyam

lines: As cloud and smoke and dust leave the sky unstained,
so stands the highest one, by Maya's workings untouched.
param-p04-v36.sanskrit_cite: jaladharadhūmarajobhir malinīkriyate yathā na gaganatalam | tadvan māyāvikṛtibhir aparāmṛṣṭaḥ paraḥ puruṣaḥ

lines: Let one jar of sky grow dusty, the rest stay clean:
so souls tasting sweet and bitter stay unstained.
param-p04-v37.sanskrit_cite: ekasmin ghaṭagagane rajasā vyāpte bhavanti nānyāni | malināni tadvad ete jīvāḥ sukhaduḥkhabhedajuṣaḥ

lines: The calm seem calm, the glad seem glad, and fools are fooled.
Amid it all the Lord is truly never so.
param-p05-v38.sanskrit_cite: śānte śānta ivāyaṃ hṛṣṭe hṛṣṭo vimohavati mūḍhaḥ | tattvagaṇe sati bhagavān na punaḥ paramārthataḥ sa tathā

lines: First wash off the shine of otherness from things,
then the highest self will shatter the lie inside.
param-p05-v39.sanskrit_cite: yad anātmany api tadrūpāvabhāsanaṃ tat purā nirākṛtya | ātmany anātmarūpāṃ bhrāntiṃ vidalayati paramātmā

lines: Cut delusion at the root, both kinds, and you are done.
No more weighing of duties for the true yogin.
param-p05-v40.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ vibhramayugalakasamūlavicchedane kṛtārthasya | kartavyāntarakalanā na jātu parayogino bhavati

lines: Earth and nature and Maya, fallen into known shapes,
turn by oneness seeing into sheer remainder of being.
param-p05-v41.sanskrit_cite: pṛthivī prakṛtir māyā tritayam idaṃ vedyarūpatāpatitam | advaitabhāvanabalād bhavati hi sanmātrapariśeṣam

lines: As belt and ring and bracelet are gold when forms are left,
so all things shine as being when difference is left.
param-p05-v42.sanskrit_cite: raśanāku.ṅdalakaṭakaṃ bhedatyāgena dṛśyate yathā hema | tadvad bhedatyāge sanmātraṃ sarvam ābhāti

lines: That holy whole, supreme and pure and still and one and even,
deathless, true, reposes in its shining power.
param-p05-v43.sanskrit_cite: tad brahma paraṃ śuddhaṃ śāntaṃ abhedātmakaṃ samaṃ sakalam | amṛtaṃ satyaṃ śaktau viśrāmyati bhāsvarūpāyām

lines: Wished and known and done by what shines: untouched,
yet it takes on the sky flower.
param-p05-v44.sanskrit_cite: iṣyata iti vedyata iti saṃpādyata iti ca bhāsvarūpeṇa | aparāmṛṣṭaṃ yad api tu nabhaḥprasūnatvam abhyeti

lines: Held in the trident's grasp, the whole world in the highest Lord,
in Siva's name, in highest truth, breathed out by gods of gods.
param-p05-v45.sanskrit_cite: śaktitriśūlaparigamayogena samastam api parameśe | śivanāmani paramārthe visṛjyate devadevena

lines: Once more the five powers spread outward in their turn,
and three bright eggs are born to find themselves outside.
param-p05-v46.sanskrit_cite: punar api ca pañcaśaktiprasaraṇakrameṇa bahir api tat | a.ṅdatrayaṃ vicitraṃ sṛṣṭaṃ bahirātmalābhena

lines: So I drive the wheel of powers in the discipline of play,
pure in form, throned as lord of the mighty wheel.
param-p06-v47.sanskrit_cite: iti śakticakrayantraṃ krīḍāyogena vāhayan devaḥ | aham eva śuddharūpaḥ śaktimahācakranāyakapadasthaḥ

lines: In me the whole world shines, as jars shine in a clean mirror.
Out of me pours all, as dreams pour from a sleeper.
param-p06-v48.sanskrit_cite: mayy eva bhāti viśvaṃ darpaṇa iva nirmale ghatādīni | mattaḥ prasarati sarvaṃ svapnavicitratvam iva suptāt

lines: I wear the shape of all that is, a body of hands and feet and such.
In everything I shine, for I am made of light.
param-p06-v49.sanskrit_cite: aham eva viśvarūpaḥ karacaranādisvabhāva iva dehaḥ | sarvasmin aham eva sphurāmi bhāveṣu bhāsvarūpam iva

lines: I see and hear and smell, yet need no flesh for senses.
No doer am I, yet I compose the scriptures and the sciences.
param-p06-v50.sanskrit_cite: draṣṭā śrotā ghrātā dehendriyavarjito 'py akartāpi | siddhāntāgamatarkāṃś citrān aham eva racayāmi

lines: Let double vision melt, cross over charming Maya,
and melt like water into water, milk in milk, into brahman.
param-p06-v51.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ dvaitavikalpe galite pravilaṅghya mohinīṃ māyām | salile salilaṃ kṣīre kṣīram iva brahmaṇi layī syāt

lines: When mind has turned the host of truths to Siva himself,
what sorrow then, what delusion?
param-p06-v52.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ tattvasamūhe bhāvanayā śivamayatvam abhiyāte | kaḥ śokaḥ ko mohaḥ sarvaṃ brahmāvalokayataḥ

lines: Good and bad luck ripen only from touching falsehood.
Hard is the stain of company, like a thief's though you never stole.
param-p06-v53.sanskrit_cite: karmaphalaṃ śubham aśubhaṃ mithyājñānena saṃgamād eva | viṣamo hi saṅgadoṣas taskarayogo 'py ataskarasyeva

lines: Fools who keep the world's business and nurse unknowing here
go round from birth to death, locked in duty's chains.
param-p06-v54.sanskrit_cite: lokavyavahārakṛtāṃ ya ihāvidyām upāsate mūḍhāḥ | te yānti janmamṛtyū dharmādharmārgalābaddhāḥ

lines: But even lifelong duties piled in ignorance time,
heaped like cotton, burn in wisdom's flame.
param-p06-v55.sanskrit_cite: ajñānakālanicitaṃ dharmādharmātmakaṃ tu karmāpi | cirasaṃcitam iva tūlaṃ naśyati vijñānadīptivaśāt

lines: The work is done, yet never for its fruit. How then rebirth?
The yoke of birth undone, the Siva sun shines by its own rays.
param-p07-v56.sanskrit_cite: jñānaprāptau kṛtam api na phalāya tato 'sya janma katham | gatajanmabandhayogo bhāti śivārkaḥ svadīdhitibhiḥ

lines: As seed freed from husk and bran makes no sprout,
so the self, loosed from stain and Maya and deed, makes none.
param-p07-v57.sanskrit_cite: tuṣakambukakiṃśārukamuktaṃ bījaṃ yathāṅkuraṃ kurute | naiva tathāṇavamāyākarmavimukto bhavāṅkuraṃ hy ātmā

lines: Who knows the self fears nothing anywhere, for all is his own shape.
He never mourns, since truly nothing ever ends.
param-p07-v58.sanskrit_cite: ātmajño na kutaścana bibheti sarvaṃ hi tasya nijarūpam | naiva ca śocati yasmāt paramārthe nāśitā nāsti

lines: From the heart's locked treasury of piled up jewels of truth,
crying I indeed, throned as the great Lord: whose ill could touch him?
param-p07-v59.sanskrit_cite: atigūḍhahṛdayagañjaprarūḍhaparamārtharatnasaṃcayataḥ | aham eveti maheśvarabhāve kā durgatiḥ kasya

lines: Freedom has no home at all, nor any road elsewhere.
Cut the knot of unknowing: your own power set free is freedom.
param-p07-v60.sanskrit_cite: mokṣasya naiva kiṃcid dhāmāsti na cāpi gamanam anyatra | ajñānagranthibhidā svaśaktyabhivyaktatā mokṣaḥ

lines: Knot cut, doubt gone, delusion thrown, merit spent,
he walks free though still wearing the body.
param-p07-v61.sanskrit_cite: bhinnājñānagranthir gatasaṃdehaḥ parākṛtabhrāntiḥ | prakṣīṇapuṇyapāpo vigrahayoge 'py asau muktaḥ

lines: As burnt seed has lost the power to sprout,
so deeds burnt in wisdom fire bear no more birth.
param-p07-v62.sanskrit_cite: agnyabhidagdhaṃ bījaṃ yathā prarohāsamarthatām eti | jñānāgnidagdham evaṃ karma na janmapradaṃ bhavati

lines: The narrow mind dreams bodies fit for its past deeds,
and shrunk awareness shines when this one falls.
param-p07-v63.sanskrit_cite: parimitabuddhitvena hi karmocitabhāvidehabhāvanayā | saṅkucitā citir etaddehadhvaṃse tathā bhāti

lines: But stainless wisdom, past all knower and doer,
spread wide, a light that never sets nor rises, true of aim
param-p07-v64.sanskrit_cite: yadi punar amalaṃ bodhaṃ sarvasamuttīrnaboddhṛkartṛmayam | vitatam anastamitoditabhārūpam satyasaṃkalpam

lines: Past place and time and touch, firm, changeless, brimful Lord,
sole maker of powers that dissolve and rise in hosts.
Wake to the self as made of Siva, maker of nature's laws.
How could he wander, spread everywhere? Whence, where, what home?
param-p08-v66.sanskrit_cite: sṛṣṭyādividhisuvedhasam ātmānaṃ śivamayaṃ vibudhyeta | katham iva saṃsārī syād vitatasya kutaḥ kva vā saraṇam

lines: So the wise prove: the knower's work is fruitless.
Not mine but his, hold firm: no fruit in all the world.
param-p08-v67.sanskrit_cite: iti yuktibhir api siddhaṃ yatkarma jñānino na saphalaṃ tat | na mamedam api tu tasyeti dārḍhyato na hi phalaṃ loke

lines: Waked by the winds of prayer, cast all thoughts in the flame of self,
and turn to flame yourself.
param-p08-v68.sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ sakalavikalpān pratibuddho bhāvanāsamīraṇataḥ | ātmajyotiṣi dīpte juhvaj jyotirmayo bhavati

lines: Eat this or that, wear anything, calm, at home everywhere,
and the self of all beings is free.
param-p08-v69.sanskrit_cite: aśnan yad vā tad vā saṃvīto yena kenacic chāntaḥ | yatra kvacana nivāsī vimucyate sarvabhūtātmā

lines: Though you staged a hundred thousand horse rites or brahmin murders,
truth knowing leaves you stainless, touched by neither score.
param-p08-v70.sanskrit_cite: hayamedhaśatasahasrāṇy api kurute brahmaghātalakṣāṇi | paramārthavin na puṇyair na ca pāpaiḥ spṛśyate vimalaḥ

lines: Drop swagger, joy, rage, lust, gloom, fear, greed, delusion.
No hymns, no rites: drift dull, with no opinions.
That swaggering host is born of seeing double.
How could it touch the one awake to oneness?
param-p08-v72.sanskrit_cite: madaharṣaprabhṛtir ayaṃ vargaḥ prabhavati vibhedasaṃmohāt | advaitātmavibodhas tena kathaṃ spṛśyatāṃ nāma

lines: Nothing apart to praise or feed with offerings.
Pleased by praise, he is free, past bowing and ritual.
